2.17.0 from NCBI

from https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/blast/executables/blast+/LATEST


Procedure to extract:
--------------------
wget https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/blast/executables/blast+/LATEST/ncbi-blast-2.17.0+-x64-linux.tar.gz
gunzip ncbi-blast-2.17.0+-x64-linux.tar.gz
tar -xvf ncbi-blast-2.17.0+-x64-linux.tar ncbi-blast-2.17.0+/bin/blastdbcmd
tar -xvf ncbi-blast-2.17.0+-x64-linux.tar ncbi-blast-2.17.0+/bin/makeblastdb
mv ./ncbi-blast-2.17.0+/bin/* .
rm -rf ncbi-blast-2.17.0*
